svg.title: WildfireGuardian vehicle unit wiring
svg.desc: Raspberry Pi 4/5 40-pin header with three MAX31855 thermocouple amplifiers (SPI0 CE0 plate, SPI0 CE1 housing, SPI1 CE0 air), BNO055 on I2C1 at 0x28, USB thermal camera, radar EVM and GNSS, and the fused 12 V to 5 V power chain. Design drawing, not verified on hardware.
svg.text: Design defaults from DESIGN.md and config/unit.yaml. Not built or verified on hardware as of 2026-11-17. Header viewed from above, pin 1 top left (SD-card end away from you).
3V3 from pin 1 to MAX31855 VIN (3.0-3.6 V part: never 5 V)
SPI0 MISO (pin 21): plate + housing boards only
SPI0 SCLK (pin 23): plate + housing boards only
K probe taped to the wall
All chip selects are kernel CS, active low: plate spidev0.0, housing
spidev0.1, air spidev1.0 (dtoverlay=spi1-1cs). No software CS needed.
Alternative (not default): air CS on GPIO25 pin 22 as a SOFTWARE CS
on SPI0, needs spidev no_cs + lgpio in the driver (not implemented).
10 nF across T+/T- at each MAX31855. MOSI pins unused (read-only).
BNO055 TX -> GPIO15 RXD (pin 10), RX -> GPIO14 TXD
USB-C plug -> USB-C(f) to USB-A(m) OTG adapter or cable
TI IWR6843AOPEVM radar (radar), stock mmw demo
micro-USB, 5 V from USB (about 2-3 W). Two serial ports enumerate:
Board must be in functional mode (SOP switch), see WIRING.md.
NMEA over USB serial, about 0.2 W; antenna needs sky view
Option: powered USB hub fed from the 5 V buck if the Pi limits USB current.
Power: 12 V accessory socket to Pi
+12 V nominal (9-16 V running; dips to about 6 V while cranking; transients above 24 V possible)
Pi 5: USB-C PD 5.1 V 5 A (27 W class)
do not back-feed 5 V via GPIO pins 2/4 unprotected
GND / 0 V: returns through the socket plug only. Copper plate and thermocouple sheaths stay isolated from chassis.
(a grounded junction makes the MAX31855 report SHORT_GND)
